clause_text: Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving the other party thirty (30) days' prior written notice.
risk_reason: Equal notice period for both sides is fair and predictable.
simplified_text: Either you or the landlord can end the agreement by giving 30 days' written notice.
tip: Keep a copy of the notice and note the date it was delivered.

clause_text: The Landlord may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving seven (7) days' notice to the Tenant, without assigning any reason.
risk_reason: Very short notice with no reason lets the landlord end the tenancy almost at will.
simplified_text: The landlord can end the agreement with just 7 days' notice and does not have to give a reason.
tip: Ask for at least 30 days' notice and a valid reason before signing.

clause_text: If either party commits a breach and fails to remedy it within fifteen (15) days of receiving written notice of the breach, the other party may terminate this Agreement.
risk_reason: A cure period gives the defaulting party a fair chance to fix the problem.
simplified_text: If someone breaks the agreement, they get 15 days after written notice to fix it before the other side can end the agreement.
tip: Always respond to a breach notice in writing within the cure period.

clause_text: This Agreement shall stand terminated on the expiry of the lease period unless renewed in writing by both parties before such expiry.
risk_reason: Ends automatically at expiry; renewal needs written agreement from both sides.
simplified_text: The agreement ends when the lease period ends unless both of you agree in writing to renew it.
tip: Diarise the expiry date and start renewal talks at least one month earlier.

clause_text: The Employer may terminate the Employee's services with immediate effect and without notice if the Employer, in its sole opinion, considers the Employee's performance unsatisfactory.
risk_reason: Sole-opinion, no-notice termination gives the employee no protection.
simplified_text: The employer can end your job immediately, without notice, if it feels your performance is not good enough.
tip: Negotiate a notice period and a written performance review process.

clause_text: Either party may terminate the Employee's engagement by giving sixty (60) days' written notice to the other party.
simplified_text: You or the employer can end your employment by giving 60 days' written notice.
tip: Check whether the notice period can be shortened by mutual consent.

clause_text: This Agreement shall be terminated by mutual written consent of both parties, and all outstanding obligations shall survive such termination until fulfilled.
risk_reason: Mutual consent required; pending obligations continue.
simplified_text: The agreement can be ended if both sides agree in writing, but unfinished obligations still have to be completed.
tip: Get the mutual termination in writing and signed by both parties.

clause_text: Upon receipt of a notice of termination, the Receiving Party shall immediately cease use of the Confidential Information, and the confidentiality obligations shall survive for a further period of three (3) years.
risk_reason: Confidentiality duties continue for years after the agreement ends.
simplified_text: Once the agreement is ended, you must stop using the confidential information, and your secrecy duty continues for 3 more years.
tip: Note the survival period and set a reminder for when it ends.

clause_text: Any breach of the confidentiality obligations under this Agreement shall render the Receiving Party liable to pay liquidated damages of Rs 10,00,000 for each such breach.
risk_reason: Fixed, very large damages per breach regardless of actual loss.
simplified_text: If you break the secrecy rules, you must pay Rs 10,00,000 for every breach, whatever the actual loss.
tip: Ask for damages tied to proven loss, or a lower cap.

clause_text: A fine of Rs 1,000 per day shall be charged to the Tenant for unauthorized parking of any vehicle in the reserved visitor area of the premises.
risk_reason: Daily fine that keeps growing until the vehicle is moved.
simplified_text: You will be fined Rs 1,000 every day your vehicle is parked in the visitor area without permission.
tip: Confirm your allotted parking slot in writing.

clause_text: Failure to submit the documents required for police verification within seven (7) days of occupation shall attract a penalty of Rs 500 per day of delay.
risk_reason: Small daily charge with a clear trigger, easy to avoid.
simplified_text: If you are late giving documents for police verification, you will pay Rs 500 for each day of delay after 7 days.
tip: Submit the documents on the first day to avoid any charge.

clause_text: The Employee who fails to complete the assigned project by the agreed deadline shall forfeit the performance bonus for that quarter and pay a penalty of Rs 25,000.
risk_reason: Loses the bonus and pays a fixed sum even for delays that may not be their fault.
simplified_text: If you miss the project deadline, you lose that quarter's bonus and must also pay Rs 25,000.
tip: Ask that penalties apply only if the delay is your fault.

clause_text: Repeated violation of the society rules by the Tenant shall attract a fine of Rs 2,000 per violation, which the Landlord may deduct from the security deposit.
risk_reason: Per-violation fine that can be taken straight from the deposit.
simplified_text: Every time you break the society rules, you can be fined Rs 2,000 and the landlord can take it from your deposit.
tip: Ask for a written list of the society rules before signing.
